full_prompt_en: A square flat graphic illustration shows two small figures standing together beneath an enormous rust-red sun in a quiet stylized park. The background is warm cream paper, lightly speckled rather than perfectly smooth. A circular red-orange sun occupies the upper left and center, its lower edge hanging just above the figures. At the right, a massive charcoal tree trunk rises beyond the top of the frame, branching into a dark canopy that cuts against the pale field. On the far left, a smaller gray tree has a rounded, simplified crown. Near the lower middle, a tall dark adult silhouette stands beside a child in a yellow-orange dress; their hands meet at the center. A small white rabbit-shaped silhouette rests on the ground just to their right, dwarfed by the tree. The figures are deliberately featureless and geometrically reduced, so scale, spacing, and color convey their relationship. A narrow dark pathway or ground strip passes behind their feet. Across the lower portion, flat golden grass and dark pointed leaves overlap in shallow layers, with a few gray mounds fading into the middle distance. Dark foliage at the lower corners frames a brighter yellow field, and the red circle balances the largest black mass on the opposite side. Light is graphic and even, with no realistic cast shadows; muted value changes within the tree and grasses suggest rough printed texture. The shapes have firm cut-paper edges, while dry grain and faint mottling keep the flat fills tactile. No words or signs appear. The overall composition is calm and slightly mysterious, using extreme changes of scale, warm earth color, and large quiet spaces to turn a simple meeting into a memorable graphic scene.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形平面图形插画呈现两个人影相依站在巨大的锈红色太阳下，地点是一处安静的风格化公园。背景是暖奶油色纸面，带有细小斑点而非完美平滑。红橙圆日占据左上和中央，下缘悬在人物上方不远处。右侧一棵巨大的炭黑树干向上越出画边，分枝成为切入浅色区域的深色树冠。最左边，一棵较小灰树带圆润简化树冠。下部中央附近，深色高大成人剪影站在一个穿黄橙裙子的孩子旁，双手在中间相接。两人右侧地面伏着一只小小的白兔形剪影，被巨树衬得更小。人物有意省去五官并化作几何形，因此尺度、间距与颜色传达他们的关系。一条窄深色路径或地面带从脚后穿过。下部平坦金色草丛与深色尖叶以浅层次互相重叠，几块灰色土丘退入中景。下角深叶丛框住更亮的黄色地带，红圆与对侧最大的黑色体块平衡。光感图形化而均匀，没有写实投影；树与草内部压低的明度变化暗示粗糙印刷质地。形状具有坚实剪纸边缘，干颗粒和淡斑驳又让平涂带触感。画中没有词语或标牌。整体构图平静而略带神秘，借尺度剧变、暖土色和大片安静空间把简单相会变成鲜明图形场景。
style_prompt_en: Flat graphic illustration relies on oversized simple geometry, sharply separated silhouettes, and selective paper-like grain. A muted cream ground holds large charcoal masses, a dominant rust-red disk, and smaller golden accents. Extreme scale contrast makes a tiny focal group legible within broad negative space; the heaviest dark form balances a bright circular color weight across the frame. Forms are flattened into a few overlapping planes rather than modeled with realistic perspective. Firm cut-paper edges carry the structure, while subtle scuffs, stipple, and uneven pigment stop the color fields from looking sterile. A low horizontal band anchors the composition and sparse pointed marks provide rhythmic texture near the bottom. Light is even and symbolic, with tonal shifts serving shape hierarchy instead of natural cast shadows. The overall effect is quiet, bold, and slightly enigmatic, combining simple visual storytelling with refined color and proportion.
style_prompt_zh: 平面图形插画依靠超大的简明几何形、分界鲜明的剪影和选择性的纸张颗粒。灰奶油色底承托大片炭黑、占主导的锈红圆盘和较小金色重音。极端尺度对照使微小焦点群在宽阔留白中仍清晰；最重深色体块与画面另一侧明亮圆形色重平衡。形体被压成少数重叠平面，而非用写实透视塑造。坚实剪纸边缘承担结构，轻微擦损、点状颗粒和不均颜料避免色域显得无菌。低位水平带稳定构图，稀疏尖形痕迹为底部提供节奏肌理。光感均匀而象征化，明度变化服务形状层级而非自然投影。整体效果安静、大胆且略显神秘，把简明的视觉叙述与精致配色和比例结合起来。
theme_en: Two small figures beneath a huge rust-red sun in a stylized park
theme_zh: 风格化公园中两个人影站在巨大的锈红太阳下
name: Pablo Lobato
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
